answer: The anchor debit happens at intake, karst totals the burned amount, and wharf anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm hence burns the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 20 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. Honest users pay that once, farms 32 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
